page.layout: One printed page, single column of text with a running head at the top; no margin notes. Blocks in reading order: running head with page number, then the text column from top to bottom, with a catchword-free foot and a signature-free foot ending in "Fu."

main_text.head: Præt.imperfect.
main_text.l: coló ro Hauéuano,& Hauéano illi habebant.
main_text.head: Pręt.perfect.
main_text.l: Io Hébbi,& Ho hauúto Ego habui.
tu Hauésti,& Hái hauúto tu habuisti.
colúi Hébbe,& Ha hauúto ille habuit.
Noi Hauémmo,& Habbiámo hauúto Nos habuimus.
vói Hauéste,& Hauéte hauúto vos habuistis.
coló ro Hébbero,& Hánno hauúto illi habuerunt.
main_text.head: Præt.plusquam perfect.
main_text.l: coló ro Haueuano hauúto illi habueraut.

page.notes: Several Latin forms are printed with irregular spelling (e.g. "Haueuano", "habueraut") and the Latin-Hebrew-style phrasing is left as printed. The right column stops on "Fu." at the foot; the rest of the foot is not visible. Some letters in the scan are faint and read with uncertainty.
